fullText.simplified:
第28章、小侦探，好久不见

    木雕佛像再次被藏花偷走了，但包厚安和周局长的对话却越来越奇怪。
    包厚安居然问周局长：“佛像这么大，你是怎么换掉的呢？”但刚刚问完，他又好像想到了答案，于是自己答道：“警察局的警车很大，昨晚你是开周局长的警车来的。来的时候，警车的后备箱里装着假佛像，离开的时候，里面放着真佛像。”
    “是这样的，你说得没错。谁会想到佛像是被警车偷走的呢？我把警车停在车库，搬佛像的时候，没有人看见，因为院子里的警察也睡着了。你看，这就是警察，真是值得信任的好警察啊！”周局长大笑起来，笑声得意极了。
    包厚安的脸因为气愤变了色，他努力让自己平静下来。过了一会儿，他问：“藏花，现在周局长在哪儿？你把他怎么样了？”
    “周局长”笑了笑，他看着包厚安，点头说：“没错，是我。小侦探，好久不见，我有点儿想你呢。放心，我没有伤害周景一。我不是和你说过吗？我只对富人的钱财感兴趣，其他的东西，我绝对不碰。现在周景一就在他的办公室里，只不过被绑住了手脚。”
    白林一直没有说话，只是站在旁边静静地看着他们，这时候他问：“藏花，昨天晚上你已经得到木雕佛像了，今天为什么还回来呢？”
    藏花看了看他，笑着说：“大侦探，我们出现在这儿的理由好像是一样的，都是为了看小侦探怎么抓藏花的。”
    白林点头：“虽然我很欣赏你的勇敢，但你打算怎么离开这儿呢？”
    藏花笑了笑，从口袋里拿出一样东西，是一把黑色的警枪——这是周局长的枪。他拿枪指着白林和包厚安，笑着说：“不要动，现在我要走了，你们还有别的问题吗？”
    包厚安说：“我还有一个问题，叶小七的那支笔，是你送给他的吗？”
    这个问题好像很有趣，藏花又笑了，他说：“我不告诉你。”
    包厚安看着他，向他走过去，藏花往后退了一步，说：“小侦探，不要过来，我会开枪的。”
    包厚安没有犹豫，他继续向前走。
    藏花把枪往旁边一指，“砰”地一声，枪响了！被射中的不是包厚安，是旁边的假佛像。玻璃柜碎了，佛像倒了，破碎的玻璃向四周飞射。白林第一时间跑过去，在飞射的碎玻璃中护住了包厚安的头。
    “再见了，小侦探！”藏花的声音消失在门口。
fullText.traditional:
第28章、小偵探，好久不見

    木雕佛像再次被藏花偷走了，但包厚安和周局長的對話卻越來越奇怪。
    包厚安居然問周局長：“佛像這麼大，你是怎麼換掉的呢？”但剛剛問完，他又好像想到了答案，於是自己答道：“警察局的警車很大，昨晚你是開周局長的警車來的。來的時候，警車的後備箱裡裝著假佛像，離開的時候，裡面放著真佛像。”
    “是這樣的，你說得沒錯。誰會想到佛像是被警車偷走的呢？我把警車停在車庫，搬佛像的時候，沒有人看見，因為院子裡的警察也睡著了。你看，這就是警察，真是值得信任的好警察啊！”周局長大笑起來，笑聲得意極了。
    包厚安的臉因為氣憤變了色，他努力讓自己平靜下來。過了一會兒，他問：“藏花，現在周局長在哪兒？你把他怎麼樣了？”
    “周局長”笑了笑，他看著包厚安，點頭說：“沒錯，是我。小偵探，好久不見，我有點兒想你呢。放心，我沒有傷害周景一。我不是和你說過嗎？我只對富人的錢財感興趣，其他的東西，我絕對不碰。現在周景一就在他的辦公室裡，只不過被綁住了手腳。”
    白林一直沒有說話，只是站在旁邊靜靜地看著他們，這時候他問：“藏花，昨天晚上你已經得到木雕佛像了，今天為什麼還回來呢？”
    藏花看了看他，笑著說：“大偵探，我們出現在這兒的理由好像是一樣的，都是為了看小偵探怎麼抓藏花的。”
    白林點頭：“雖然我很欣賞你的勇敢，但你打算怎麼離開這兒呢？”
    藏花笑了笑，從口袋裡拿出一樣東西，是一把黑色的警槍——這是周局長的槍。他拿槍指著白林和包厚安，笑著說：“不要動，現在我要走了，你們還有別的問題嗎？”
    包厚安說：“我還有一個問題，叶小七的那支筆，是你送給他的嗎？”
    這個問題好像很有趣，藏花又笑了，他說：“我不告訴你。”
    包厚安看著他，向他走過去，藏花往後退了一步，說：“小偵探，不要過來，我會開槍的。”
    包厚安沒有猶豫，他繼續向前走。
    藏花把槍往旁邊一指，“砰”地一聲，槍響了！被射中的不是包厚安，是旁邊的假佛像。玻璃櫃碎了，佛像倒了，破碎的玻璃向四周飛射。白林第一時間跑過去，在飛射的碎玻璃中護住了包厚安的頭。
    “再見了，小偵探！”藏花的聲音消失在門口。

sentences.pinyin: bèi shè zhòng de bú shì bāo hòu ān shì páng biān de jiǎ fó xiàng
sentences.english: It didn’t hit Bao Houan, but the fake Buddha statue on the side.

sentences.simplified: 玻璃柜碎了，佛像倒了，破碎的玻璃向四周飞射。
sentences.traditional: 玻璃櫃碎了，佛像倒了，破碎的玻璃向四周飛射。
sentences.pinyin: bō li guì suì le fó xiàng dǎo le pò suì de bō li xiàng sì zhōu fēi shè
sentences.english: The glass case shattered, the Buddha statue fell over, and broken glass flew in all directions.

sentences.simplified: 白林第一时间跑过去，在飞射的碎玻璃中护住了包厚安的头。
sentences.traditional: 白林第一時間跑過去，在飛射的碎玻璃中護住了包厚安的頭。
sentences.pinyin: bái lín dì yī shí jiān pǎo guò qu zài fēi shè de suì bō li zhōng hù zhù le bāo hòu ān de tóu
sentences.english: Bai Lin ran over immediately and shielded Bao Houan’s head from the flying shards.

sentences.simplified: “再见了，小侦探！”藏花的声音消失在门口。
sentences.traditional: “再見了，小偵探！”藏花的聲音消失在門口。
sentences.pinyin: zài jiàn le xiǎo zhēn tàn cáng huā de shēng yīn xiāo shī zài mén kǒu
sentences.english: “Farewell, young detective!” Cang Hua’s voice disappeared through the door.

sentence_translations: Chapter 28: Young Detective, Long Time No See
Cang Hua also stole the wooden Buddha statue.
Meanwhile, the conversation between Bao Houan and Police Chief Zhou was getting more and more strange.
Bao Houan even asked Police Chief Zhou, “The Buddha statue is so big. How did you replace it?”
But just as he asked this, he seemed to have come up with the answer, so he answered himself:
“The police car from the police station is really big. Last night, you drove Police Chief Zhou’s police car here.
When you arrived, the trunk of the police car contained the fake Buddha statue. When you left, the real Buddha statue was inside.”
“That’s it, you’re right. Who would think that the Buddha statue would be stolen inside a police car?
I parked the police car in the garage, and no one saw me when I moved the Buddha statue because the police in the yard were also asleep.
Look, this is the police. The good police officers who we should trust!”
Police Chief Zhou burst into laughter. His laughter was extremely self-satisfied.
Bao Houan’s face changed color with anger. He struggled to calm himself down.
After a while, he asked, “Cang Hua, where is Police Chief Zhou right now? What have you done to him?”
“Police Chief Zhou” laughed. He looked at Bao Houan, nodded, and said, ..
.. “You’re right, it is me. Young detective, long time no see. I missed you a little. Don’t worry, I haven’t hurt Zhou Jingyi.
Didn’t I tell you before? I’m only interested in rich people’s money. Anything else, I absolutely won’t touch.
Right now, Zhou Jingyi is in his office. It’s just that his hands and feet are tied.”
Bai Lin hadn’t said anything the whole time. He had just been standing on the side, silently watching them.
At this point, he asked, “Cang Hua, you already stole the wooden Buddha last night. Why did you still come back today?”
Cang Hua looked at him and said with a smile, ..
.. “Great detective, it seems that we both came here for the same reason. We both came to see how the young detective catches Cang Hua.”
Bai Lin nodded, “Although I really admire your courage, how do you plan on leaving here?”
Cang Hua smiled and took an object out of his pocket. It was a black police gun—Police Chief Zhou’s gun.
He held the gun and pointed it at Bai Lin and Bao Houan.
He smiled as he said, “Don’t move. I will leave now. Do you have any other questions?”
Bao Houan said. “I have another question. Ye Xiaoqi’s pen, was it you who gave it to him?”
This question seemed to be very interesting. Cang Hua smiled again and said, “I’m not telling you.”
Bao Houan looked at him and walked toward him. Cang Hua took a step back and said, “Young detective, don’t come over here. I will shoot.”
Bao Houan didn’t hesitate. He continued walking straight ahead.
Cang Hua pointed the gun to the side, and with a “bang”, the gun fired!
It didn’t hit Bao Houan, but the fake Buddha statue on the side.
The glass case shattered, the Buddha statue fell over, and broken glass flew in all directions.
Bai Lin ran over immediately and shielded Bao Houan’s head from the flying shards.
“Farewell, young detective!” Cang Hua’s voice disappeared through the door.
